Orthographic high three-quarter view, viewed from above at about 55 degrees, front towards bottom of image, warm upper-left light. Crisp deliberate pixel clusters, sharp dark contour, restrained detailed shading, NOT blurry illustration. One complete isolated object, centered with 12% clear padding on every side, no ground, no cast shadow, no scene, no lettering, brands, watermark or labels. Background: genuinely transparent alpha if possible; otherwise perfectly flat solid #ff00ff magenta for our authorized offline cutout pipeline, no gradients or checkerboard. Object contains no magenta. Designed to remain instantly legible at the specified small native resolution. Image 1 is the design reference for the knife being improved. Keep this recognizable Taramundi pocketknife design: ochre wooden rounded handle, broad black diagonal burned stripes, TWO red rings, short shiny steel ferrule and one OPEN silver leaf-shaped blade, NO lettering on blade. Improve readability: broader stout handle and broader clear blade, fewer larger contrasting marks, no fine noisy hatching. Blade points to lower-left, handle to upper-right, diagonal about 30 degrees rather than steep45. Intended native footprint 48 by 30 pixels. Entire knife including blade tip and handle must be fully visible.
